description: WhatsApp now has a new global head, Will Cathcart revealed, while announcing that Kunal Shah will take over from him to head the instant messaging platform. This comes as Mark Zuckerberg-led Meta has entered Cred as the new minority shareholder, which Shah founded in 2018. Cathcart held the position of global head of WhatsApp for more than seven years. WhatsApp introduced end-to-end encryption messaging, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), and more features under Cathcart’s leadership.
title: In a Massive Shakeup, Meta Appoints CRED’s Kunal Shah to Lead WhatsApp Globally as Will Cathcart Exits

description: OnePlus 16T is said to be in the works for the Chinese market. The company is yet to confirm its existence, but a recent leak suggests that it will run on Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 processor, built on an advanced 2nm manufacturing process. It could feature a 6.3-inch display with a high refresh rate. This model could succeed the OnePlus 15T, which was introduced in China earlier this year.
title: OnePlus 16T Display, Chipset Details Leaked Months Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: PS5 users won't need a PS Plus subscription to play Halo: Campaign Evolved split screen co-op, Halo Studios has clarified. However, all users will need a Microsoft account and an Xbox Gamertag to access the game. Halo: Campaign Evolved will launch on July 28 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X.
title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Won't Require PS Plus for Local Split Screen Co-Op on PS5, Halo Studios Clarifies

description: Apple's iPhone Air 2 is rumoured to feature an A20 series chip. This could be a downgrade compared to the iPhone 18 Pro models, which are expected to ship with a more advanced A20 Pro.  A new leak also suggests an upgraded dual rear camera unit, including two 48-megapixel sensors. The iPhone Air 2 is expected to go official next year alongside the standard iPhone 18. The existing iPhone Air runs on the A19 Pro chipset.
title: iPhone Air 2 to Arrive With Chip Downgrade and Two Rear Cameras, Tipster Claims

description: Honor X80 Pro Max has been launched in China as the latest addition to the smartphone maker’s mid-range X lineup. The handset is set to go on sale in the country via the Honor China online store. The Honor X80 Pro Max is offered in four colour options, namely Lightning Red, Moonlight White, Mystic Black, and Vibrant Orange (translated from Chinese). The smartphone is equipped with a single 50-megapixel rear camera, housed inside a circular camera module. Moreover, it packs an 11,000mAh battery with support for 90W wired fast charging and 27W wired reverse charging.
title: Honor X80 Pro Max Launched With 11,000mAh Battery, '10,000-Nit' Display: Price, Specifications

description: In recent weeks, Apple has been rumoured to be raising the prices of iPhone, iPad, and other products. While CEO Tim Cook recently acknowledged that increasing memory and storage costs could force the company to pass higher expenses on to customers, the official stopped short of revealing when the increases could come into effect. A seasoned journalist has now suggested that the price hikes could be imminent as Apple navigates rising component costs.
title: iPhone, iPad and Mac Price Hikes Could Be 'Fairly Imminent': Mark Gurman

description: Secret Network has suffered a $4.67 million exploit after attackers abused an infinite mint vulnerability in a smart contract linked to Axelar-wrapped assets. The flaw allowed the creation of unbacked tokens, which were later redeemed for genuine assets held in escrow. The incident went undetected for nearly a week before being discovered following a failed cross-chain transaction, making it one of the largest crypto exploits reported this month.
title: Secret Network Bridge Suffers $4.7 Million Exploit Due to Infinite Mint Bug

description: SK Hynix now the dominant supplier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) chips used in AI systems for customers such as Nvidia and Alphabet's Google, has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the global AI boom, propelling a more than 340 percent rally in its shares this year and lifting its market value above both Samsung and Micron.
title: SK Hynix Overtakes Samsung to Become South Korea's Most Valuable Company

description: Many smartphones will launch new 4G handsets in India between July and September, before the festive season begins in October, a tipster claims. The upcoming 4G-only phones will reportedly be priced in India under Rs. 25,000. This is slightly higher than for the 4G smartphones that were recently launched in the country, taking them to the mid-range price segment. However, the leaker neither revealed the names of the soon-to-be-launched handsets nor the names of the brands.
title: Mid-Range 4G Phones Tipped to Launch in India Between July and September, ‘Many’ Models Expected

description: After months of anticipation since the release of the first trailer, Rockstar Games finally announced the pre-order date for Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6). While there are quite a few months to go before players can get their hands on the highly anticipated open-world action-adventure title, cybersecurity researchers have warned that the growing anticipation is also creating an opportunity for scammers. According to a new report, eager fans are increasingly being targeted with fake beta invitations, fraudulent pre-order offers, and malware-laden downloads.
title: GTA 6 Fake 'Beta' Invitations Used to Target Players With Promise of Early Access, Researchers Warn

description: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition will be launched in India on June 24 at 12 pm IST, the company revealed on Monday. The new handset will go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition will sport a carbon fibre finish with a 360-degree “aerospace-grade” aluminium frame. It will be offered in at least a black colourway. The company has confirmed that the Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition will be equipped with a 6,500mAh battery, while featuring support for 90W wired fast charging and 30W wireless charging.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition India Launch Date Revealed Along With Design: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 have received store updates on PC and Xbox storefronts. While the games cost $40 each, the DLC prices have been decreased, suggesting PlayStation pricing for the upcoming ports from Iron Galaxy. Black Ops 1 and 2 will be ported to PlayStation consoles next month.
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops 2 Store Updates on Xbox, PC Hint at PlayStation Pricing

description: Tecno Camon Slim was launched in select markets in five different colour options. It runs on a MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate processor alongside up to 8GB RAM. It carries a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA 600 camera. This new phone has an IP69 + IP68 rated build and a 5,600mAh battery. It has a 6.78-inch AMOLED panel with a 144Hz refresh rate and 1.5K resolution.
title: Tecno Camon Slim With MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate, 144Hz Display Launched: Specifications

description: Crypto exchange WhiteBIT has secured a MiCA licence from Austria’s Financial Market Authority, allowing it to provide services across the European Economic Area through a single authorisation. The approval comes less than two weeks before the EU’s MiCA transition period expires on July 1, after which exchanges operating under legacy national registrations will need a MiCA licence or be required to halt services within the bloc.
title: WhiteBIT Receives MiCA Licence in Austria as EU Deadline Nears

description: The Xiaomi 18 series is expected to launch later this year as the company’s next-generation flagship lineup. It is expected to comprise the Xiaomi 18, 18 Pro, and 18 Pro Max models. While the company has yet to announce any details about the purported handsets, a recent leak suggests that the Xiaomi 18 Pro could sport a 2K resolution display. Xiaomi is also said to be experimenting with hardware and software-based privacy protection features, similar to the Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Tipped to Feature 2K Screen With Privacy Display Feature; Launch Timeline Leaked

description: Bitcoin traded near $64,000 on Monday as investors weighed geopolitical uncertainty and awaited key US economic data. Analysts said caution around inflation, growth, and labour market indicators, along with subdued institutional participation, continued to limit bullish momentum. Market participants are also monitoring Bitcoin’s key support and resistance levels for signs of the market’s next directional move.
title: Bitcoin Price Rises Above $64,000 Despite Macroeconomic Uncertainty

description: Oppo Find N7 will be launched as the tech firm’s first wide-folding smartphone next year, a tipster claims. The smartphone is tipped to be equipped with a foldable screen on the inside with a minimal crease in the middle. The foldable is said to boast a similar display technology to this year’s Oppo Find N6, which also sports a “creaseless” screen on the inside. On top of this, the Oppo Find N7 might launch a horizontal rear camera module, unlike its predecessor, which features a circular camera island.
title: Oppo Find N7 Tipped to Launch as Firm's First Wide-Folding Handset With Find N6's Crease-Free Screen

description: John Ternus needs to prioritise making Apple's products cool again, and the new CEO will place less emphasis on the financial engineering that characterised much of the Cook era. The new CEO will emphasise product engineering, design and innovation. Ternus has reportedly spent considerable time working closely with designers and is expected to take this engagement to the next level after taking over the CEO post.
title: Apple to Revive Company’s Design Team, Leadership Under John Ternus: Mark Gurman

description: Nothing Phone 4b is expected to be launched in India soon, as the Carl Pei-led smartphone maker has started teasing the debut of a new handset with the 4b branding. On top of this, a dedicated microsite for the upcoming “b” series device is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in India via the e-commerce website. In terms of design, the purported Nothing Phone 4b is shown to be equipped with a single rear camera system. Moreover, the smartphone will sport the brand’s signature transparent rear panel, with exposed screws and other components. It could also get a flat back, along with rounded corners, similar to the higher-end Phone 4a series.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Design Teased, Microsite Hints at Imminent Launch in India

description: Sony has reportedly backed away from releasing its first-party single-player games on PC this year. Now, the PlayStation parent seems to have made the shift in strategy official with an SEC filing. In its business document filed with the US SEC, the company has reportedly dropped the mention of PC ports of its games.
title: Sony Reportedly Removes PC Ports Reference from Business Report Filed to SEC Amidst Shift to PS5 Exclusives

description: The OnePlus 13T was launched in China last year as the company’s compact flagship smartphone. In subsequent months, a tweaked variant of the handset debuted in India as the OnePlus 13s. While it was believed that its successor, ubiquitously known as the OnePlus 15s, could launch this year, a tipster suggests that the company may not bring it to the Indian market after all. Apart from this, details surrounding the OnePlus 16 are also said to be uncertain.
title: OnePlus 15s Unlikely to Launch in India, OnePlus 16 Debut Remains Uncertain, Tipster Claims

description: HMD Luma 2 could launch soon. Ahead of the official launch, the colour options and specifications of the HMD Luma 2 have leaked online. It is said to be available in ice blue, light sand and midnight lake colour options. It could offer a 6.75-inch panel and a Unisoc chipset. It is likely to feature a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and a 6,000mAh battery with support for 18W fast charging.
title: HMD Luma 2 Design Revealed via Leaked Renders; Tipped to Feature 6,000mAh Battery, 6.75-Inch Display

description: Samsung could launch the Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 next month. A new leak suggests the software-based renders of Samsung’s upcoming wearables, revealing several design and software changes expected with the next-generation Galaxy Watch lineup. Samsung's next wearable generation might not include a Classic variant. The new lineup could include new band designs, fresh colour options, updated watch faces, and additional features as part of One UI 9 Watch. The Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is said to feature a slightly boxier design and slimmer bezels. It could feature a toned-down Quick Button design.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9, Watch Ultra 2 Leak Shows New Design, Colours and Features

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE has been sighted on various certification platforms lately, hinting towards its imminent arrival. While the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to confirm its next-generation ‘Fan Edition' handset, its Korean variant has been spotted on a benchmarking platform. The latest listing suggests that Samsung may stick with its in-house Exynos chipset strategy for the smartphone. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE could run on Android 17 and ship with at least 8GB of RAM.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Korean Variant Spotted on Geekbench With Exynos 2500 SoC, 8GB RAM

description: Oppo Reno 16 series will be launched in India soon, the smartphone maker revealed on Sunday. Additionally, dedicated microsites for the upcoming Reno 16 lineup are now live in the country on Amazon and Flipkart, confirming its availability in India via the two e-commerce platforms. Along with the Oppo Reno 16 series, the tech firm has also teased the launch of the Oppo Bubble accessory, which acts as a magnetically attached secondary display for the Reno 16 series phones. Moreover, the company will also launch a new Oppo Enco series true wireless stereo (TWS) in the country.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series India Launch Teased; Could Arrive Alongside Oppo Bubble Accessory and New Enco Series Headset

description: The Sennheiser HD 480 Pro Plus is a premium closed-back headphone aimed at professionals and enthusiasts alike. It offers a lightweight design, strong passive noise isolation, and a balanced sound signature that prioritises long-term listening comfort over flashy tuning. While the price tag is undeniably steep, the headphones focus on consistency and practicality, making them an intriguing option for those seeking a dependable wired listening experience. But is that enough to justify spending Rs. 47,999?
title: Sennheiser HD 480 Pro Plus Review: Quietly Impressive

description: With the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 now firmly in the rear window, the focus is shifting towards Apple's September event. While details officially remain under wraps, the rumour mill suggests that the next two years could spell one of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s most ambitious hardware roadmaps yet. A seasoned journalist claims Apple is preparing a plethora of new product launches, including a foldable iPhone, camera-equipped AirPods, smart glasses, wearables, and robotic smart home devices.
title: Apple’s Future Product Roadmap to Reportedly Include Foldable iPhone, AI Glasses, and Camera AirPods
